question: The age of the Earth is currently thought to be:
solution:
The correct answer is __**4.5 billion years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The age of the earth is **approx. 4.543 billion years**.
 
• The **oldest rocks** on Earth found to date are the **Acasta Gneiss in northwestern Canada** near the **Great Slave Lake**, which are 4.03 billion years old.
 
• Researchers in **Australia **found the oldest **mineral grains** on Earth.
 
• These **tiny zirconium silicate** crystals have ages that reach 4.3 billion years, making them the oldest terrestrial materials found on Earth so far.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The age of rocks is determined by **radiometric dating**.
 
• In **1862, the physicist William Thomson** published calculations that fixed the age of Earth.
 
• Radiometric dating calculates an age in years for geologic materials by measuring the presence of a short-life radioactive element.
 
• Radiocarbon dating uses the carbon isotopes **carbon-14 and carbon-12.**
